shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && ls -a && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cat next.config.ts tsconfig.json app/*.tsx; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -ril "proxy.ts" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; ls 03-file-conventions | grep -i -E "proxy|instrument"; grep -n -i -B2 -A30 "matcher" 03-file-conventions/proxy.md | head -120; grep -rn -i "log.*request\|onRequest" 03-file-conventions/instrumentation.md | head

cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15 && (npx next start -p 3456 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s -o /dev/null "localhost:3456/?a=1" && curl -s -o /dev/null localhost:3456/nope && sleep 1 && cat /tmp/srv.log; pkill -f "next start"
